meta.name: The Crystal Cuckoo
meta.description: Hoping to learn more about her heart donor, a young doctor arrives in a mountain town where decades of mysterious tragedies plague the small community.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A tragic fire arouses an officer's suspicion. Decades later, his son's heart saves a doctor who comes to town hoping to learn more about her donor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Clara joins the search party after the latest disappearance. Back in the past, Miguel looks for answers about the fire but his efforts are shut down.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Unsettled by his findings, Miguel delves deeper into his sister's disappearance. At the Tamborada festival, Clara learns more about Carlos and the town.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Miguel's obsession with the investigation causes friction at home. Clara makes sense of Carlos' discoveries as Juan delivers Marta a shocking truth.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In 1979, a young Yesques resident receives a severe warning from his mother. Years later, Miguel's growing doubts lead to an unexpected tragedy.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After another shocking event hits Yesques, the authorities do their best to prevent a tragic outcome while a helpless Marta fears the worst.
